paragraphs: Your secret weapon might just be a team meeting agenda. Too often relegated to an afterthought, this handy tool can go a long way to help you run more effective in-person or virtual meetings. It helps with managing time, setting expectations, and staying on the task at hand. Agendas ensure that you have a clear purpose and that you can achieve the goals you set, whether you’re plotting your quarterly budget or creating a project timeline – real, shareable results.

Date, time, and location: These details are especially important for dispersed teams. Be mindful of where everyone is and specify which time zone you’re in. As for the location, these days it might be a Zoom link or another chat channel instead of a physical location, so don’t forget to include that as well.

It’s also worth noting that agendas need to be circulated to all participants at least a day before the meeting. Doing so ensures that your team has had a chance to review what projects and assignments will be covered so that they come prepared for discussion. You might also welcome some feedback from your team in case you missed a thing or two.
translations: 一份团队会议议程能帮助你更有效地组织线下或线上会议。它有助于管理时间、设定预期并聚焦讨论。议程能明确会议目的，帮助团队实现既定目标，形成可共享的实际成果。
日期、时间和地点：对于分散办公的团队尤其重要。请考虑每个人所在的位置，并注明时区。地点可以是 Zoom 链接或聊天频道，不一定是实体场所。
议程应至少提前一天发给所有参与者。这样团队就有时间查看将要讨论的项目和任务并提前准备。你也可以请大家补充遗漏的内容。
fullTextParagraphs: How to write an effective team meeting agenda (with templates!)

Your secret weapon might just be a team meeting agenda. Too often relegated to an afterthought, this handy tool can go a long way to help you run more effective in-person or virtual meetings. It helps with managing time, setting expectations, and staying on the task at hand. Agendas ensure that you have a clear purpose and that you can achieve the goals you set, whether you’re plotting your quarterly budget or creating a project timeline – real, shareable results.
Team meeting agendas also help you prioritize the things you want to talk about, so you can guide your team through the most important topics of the week.
Every team meeting agenda should include the following basic elements to keep everyone in the loop:

Date, time, and location: These details are especially important for dispersed teams. Be mindful of where everyone is and specify which time zone you’re in. As for the location, these days it might be a Zoom link or another chat channel instead of a physical location, so don’t forget to include that as well.

Objective and goals: Use this as your North Star. Ask yourself, “What type of meeting is this? What am I trying to get out of it?” Be straightforward with everyone else about it so everyone’s on the same page and stays focused on the task at hand.

It’s also worth noting that agendas need to be circulated to all participants at least a day before the meeting. Doing so ensures that your team has had a chance to review what projects and assignments will be covered so that they come prepared for discussion. You might also welcome some feedback from your team in case you missed a thing or two.
verifiedFacts: Atlassian 的公开资料明确介绍了“会前发议程时，怎样把目标、议题和准备事项说清楚”相关的工作做法。
练习情境为虚构职场训练，不代表公司真实员工对话。

notes.example: Please send the agenda at least a day before.

scenario.title: Atlassian工作场景练习（虚构）
english: A product team in three time zones needs to choose one of two onboarding flows. Participants must review customer feedback before a 30-minute meeting.
Write an invite with the decision goal, meeting time zone, and a clear preparation deadline.
chinese: 产品团队分布在三个时区，需要从两套新用户引导流程中选一套。参会者要在 30 分钟会议前查看客户反馈。
写一封邀请，说明决策目标、会议时区和明确的会前准备期限。

firstAttempt.prompt: 请给产品团队写一封会议邀请：目标是选定一套新用户引导流程；注明会议为北京时间周四 16:00；请大家至少提前一天查看客户反馈。
firstAttempt.sample: Hi team, our goal for Thursday’s meeting is to choose one onboarding flow. We’ll meet at 4:00 p.m. Beijing time and compare the two options. Please review the customer feedback at least a day before.
firstAttempt.rationale: 先独立组织信息，再比较示范中的目标、行动和时间表达。
